item.title: Aputure Announces NOVA 9° 2x1 and NOVA II 1x1 panel lights
item.description: Aputure has introduced two new NOVA LED panel fixtures, the NOVA 9° 2x1 hyper narrow beam panel and the NOVA II 1x1, alongside a new three-panel yoke array and a range of accessories.

item.title: OBSBOT Tiny 3 Series Launches with Spatial Audio and AI Tracking
item.description: OBSBOT has launched the Tiny 3 and Tiny 3 Lite, two new AI-powered 4K PTZ webcams that place a particular emphasis on integrated audio alongside upgraded imaging and tracking features.

item.title: Sony Unveils Cinema Line Firmware Roadmap Through 2026: VENICE 2, BURANO, FX6 & FR7 Details
item.description: Sony has released new information regarding forthcoming firmware releases for the VENICE 2 and BURANO, as well as confirming availability for FX6 V6.0 and FR7 V4.0 firmware releases.

item.title: Apple Enters Brave New Gated World with Creator Studio
item.description: Apple Creator Studio has just rolled out, and to be honest it feels a bit jarring as it intrudes on your day even if you're just writing something in Pages.

item.title: Elevate.io Launches Editable Embedded Captions and One-Click Transcription | Video Workflow Innovation
item.description: elevate.io's new captioning and transcription technology embeds captions in source media, making subtitles editable throughout the entire edit workflow.

item.title: DJI Launches the RS 5 Lightweight Commercial Gimbal with Enhanced Tracking, Stability, and Runtime
item.description: The DJI RS 5 is an all-new, lightweight commercial camera gimbal that DJI says introduces improved intelligent subject tracking, stability and control mechanisms, and a longer runtime.

item.title: Canon Announces Multi-Camera Orchestration (MCO) to Simplify Multi-Camera PTZ Production
item.description: Canon has announced Multi-Camera Orchestration, a new system designed to let a single operator run a professional multi-camera production using its PTZ cameras.

item.title: Final Cut Pro 12 launches with AI search tools and deeper Creator Studio ties
item.description: Final Cut Pro 12 is one of the central planks in Apple's new Creator Studio subscription offering, but its major version status seems more about integration with that than any radical new features.

item.title: Inside the Edit: How David Barker Edited 'Chasing Summer'
item.description: Chasing Summer has been one of the most talked-about movies at Sundance this year. We went inside the edit with the film's editor David Barker.

item.title: The Three Data Backup Mistakes That Still Kill Productions
item.description: Replay: Backing up footage isn’t just about making copies. It’s about making the right copies, in the right places, every time. Because the real horror story isn’t a drive failure — it’s discovering too late that you’ve carefully archived the wrong card, the wrong folder, or nothing at all.
